# The Vault

> A free, private Magic: The Gathering collection manager. Each person's collection (imported
> from Dragon Shield) is priced daily from Scryfall, with saved decks, deck coverage and
> sharing. People can connect their own AI agents to their own data.

Everything is private to its owner. Agents act for one person, with a personal access token
that person created (Account → Agents & API in the app). The token can be read-only or
read-write, and it expires.

## Connect an agent (MCP)

- MCP server: `/api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, stateless JSON). Header: `Authorization: Bearer vault_pat_...`
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http vault https://<host>/api/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer vault_pat_..."`
- Tools:
  - collection: `get_collection_summary`, `search_cards`, `get_card`, `list_sets`,
    `get_collection_stats`, `get_value_history`, `get_acquisition_timeline`
  - decks: `check_decklist`, `parse_decklist`, `list_decks`, `get_deck`, `save_deck`,
    `update_deck`, `get_archidekt_deck`
  - imports and sharing: `list_imports`, `import_collection_csv`, `list_shared_with_me`,
    `get_shared_deck`
- A read-only token doesn't list the write tools.

## Or use the HTTP API directly

- Start at `GET /api/v1` and follow `_links`. The OpenAPI description is at `/api/openapi.json`,
  and the interactive docs are at `/api/docs`.
- Lists are pages: `{"items", "count", "total", "_links": {"next"}}`. Follow `next`; at most
  500 items per page. Never expect one huge answer.
- Send `If-None-Match` with a response's `ETag`; you get `304` while nothing changed.
  `GET /api/v1/collection` has a `version` that changes whenever the data does.
- Retries: GETs are safe to repeat. For POSTs, send `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>`, and a repeat
  returns the first answer (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of doing the work twice.
  After a 429 or 503, wait for `Retry-After`.
- Errors are `application/problem+json`: `{"title", "status", "detail"}`. A 403 with
  `insufficient_scope` means the token is read-only.
- Useful endpoints:
  - `/api/v1/collection/cards?sort=-value&limit=25`
  - `/api/v1/collection/cards?q=bolt`
  - `POST /api/v1/decks/coverage {"text": "1 Sol Ring\n4 Lightning Bolt"}`

## Credit

Card data, images and prices come from Scryfall (https://scryfall.com). When you show card
images, name the artist and Scryfall, and don't crop the images. The Vault is unofficial Fan Content permitted under
the Fan Content Policy, not approved or endorsed by Wizards. Portions of the materials used are
property of Wizards of the Coast. ©Wizards of the Coast LLC.
